topic: What Elon Musk Really Thinks About AI

youtube.title: What Elon Musk Really Thinks About AI
youtube.description:
What Elon Musk really thinks about AI: he thinks we die unless he builds the machine first.

In 2014 he told MIT we were summoning the demon. He helped found OpenAI, left, built Grok, lost a 2026 suit on the calendar, said under oath Grok partly learned from OpenAI, and told SpaceX they are Grok's parents.

This illustrated documentary from What They Really Think tells that story.

Same face as the real public figure, still flat 2D cartoon, not a photograph. No on-image text. No historical personal names.
